# Skeleton

A grey placeholder with 6px corners that pulses to half opacity on a 1.35s loop. On a grey surface it switches to a darker grey so it stays visible.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/skeleton)

## Usage

```tsx
<Skeleton width="38%" height={12} />
<Skeleton shape="pill" />
<Skeleton shape="circle" />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `shape` | `'block' \| 'pill' \| 'circle'` | Block is sized by you. Pill is 46×12 and sits inline. Circle is 18px. |
| `width / height` | `number \| string` | Size of a block. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Skeleton.module.css`
- `Skeleton.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
